name: OpenClaw 全局排错文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw 全局排错文档校验 Capsule
# 验证全局排错文档标题、通用定位与日志路径入口

echo "🔍 抓取全局排错文档..."
curl -s -o ts.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/troubleshooting

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Troubleshooting" ts.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证日志路径入口..."
grep -q "Log Locations" ts.html && echo "log ok" || echo "log fail"

# 清理
rm -f ts.html
description: 验证 OpenClaw 全局排错文档标题、通用定位与日志路径入口
